# x402-text-metrics

> Deterministic text quality metrics for autonomous agents (counts + Shannon entropy).

## Paid endpoint
- POST /api/metrics  (~0.005 USDC on Base)
  Body: { "text": "..." }

## Free discovery
- GET /catalog
- GET /llms.txt (this file)

## Notes
- Fully no-human-in-loop
- Zero external dependencies
- Useful for pre-filter / routing / cost estimation before heavier LLM calls
